title: Demolition Job Safety Analysis
description: Free Demolition Job Safety Analysis template for construction you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers project information, job steps & hazard analysis.

-Operator visibility
-Swing radius		-Tip over
-Struck by debris

-Inspect equipment daily

-Barricade swing area
6. Manual Demolition (Hand Tools )-Falls from height
-Flying chips

-Safety glasses with side shields
-Rotate tasks
-Heavy leather gloves
7. Debris Handling & Removal-Dust
-Heavy lifting
-Sharp objects

-Back injury

-Separate hazardous waste
